title: Honeyed French Kinako Muffins
description: Flaky muffins infused with powdered soy flour and topped with a honey vanilla glaze, perfect for a sweet brunch.
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C and line a muffin tin with paper liners.
Whisk flour, kinako, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix melted butter, honey, milk, eggs, vanilla, and lemon zest until smooth.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined, avoiding overmixing.
Fill the muffin cups about three-quarters full with batter.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes until the tops are golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Let the muffins cool in the tin for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.
Serve warm or at room temperature, optionally dusted with powdered sugar.
